requirements.quote: Details of possession of Quality certifications – ISO 9001, IS 16444 and Type approval certificates /BIS /International accreditations if any
requirements.text: Provide details of quality certifications and type approval certificates.

requirements.quote: Technical presentation and Technical literature/Brochures of the offered Smart Energy Meter along with AMI Solutions.
requirements.text: Submit technical presentation and literature for the offered Smart Energy Meter and AMI solutions.

requirements.quote: Clause-by-Clause compliance of RFP terms (Pre-qualification requirements, Eligibility criteria & General Requirements) and all corrigendum with supporting documents as per Annexure-II.
requirements.text: Provide clause-by-clause compliance of RFP terms with supporting documents.

requirements.quote: Valid Power of Attorney along with resolution of Board for authorizing the person signing the bid for this RFP.
requirements.text: Submit a valid Power of Attorney and Board resolution for bid signing authorization.

requirements.quote: Undertaking by the TP shall be submitted as per Annexure-III.
requirements.text: Submit an undertaking as per Annexure-III.

requirements.quote: An undertaking of owning IPR (Intellectual Property Right) or Copyright/License for the design to be submitted.
requirements.text: Provide an undertaking of owning IPR or copyright/license for the design.

requirements.quote: An undertaking to have understood and ready to sign a contract agreement by the appropriate authority immediately after being selected.
requirements.text: Submit an undertaking to sign a contract agreement upon selection.

requirements.quote: A Pre-Contract Integrity Pact as per the format given in Annexure-IV.
requirements.text: Submit a Pre-Contract Integrity Pact as per Annexure-IV.

requirements.quote: A Bid Security declaration in lieu of the Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) as per format given in Annexure-V.
requirements.text: Provide a Bid Security declaration as per Annexure-V.

requirements.quote: Compliance in Generic Specification provided in Annexure-VI
requirements.text: Ensure compliance with the Generic Specification in Annexure-VI.

requirements.quote: Financial Bid duly filled & signed both in PDF and Excel format as per Annexure-VII to be uploaded in ITI Tender Portal.
requirements.text: Submit the financial bid in PDF and Excel format as per Annexure-VII.

requirements.quote: Declaration of Relation as per Annexure-VIII.
requirements.text: Provide a Declaration of Relation as per Annexure-VIII.
Submit an NDA as per Annexure-IX.

requirements.quote: Land border declaration as per Annexure-X
requirements.text: Provide a land border declaration as per Annexure-X.

requirements.quote: Certificate to be submitted by Bidders on Rule 144(xi) of the General Financial Rules (GFRs) 2017 on grounds of Defence of India and National Security as per Annexure-XI
requirements.text: Submit a certificate on Rule 144(xi) of GFRs 2017 as per Annexure-XI.
Provide a consortium agreement as per Annexure-XII.

requirements.quote: In case of Consortium, all members of Consortium have to separately submit the documents as per the check list above.
requirements.text: All consortium members must submit the required documents separately.

requirements.text: MSE vendors must submit documents to claim benefits.
